column1: # MeCandidate packed to ONE BYTE (C's own width) — peak heap AND peak RSS, port and C.
# grid: content=gradient  sizes={1280,1536,1920,2048} square  qp=40  preset=13  8-bit 4:2:0
# arms: still = perf_encode default; videokey = SVTAV1_VIDEO=1 + the matched low-delay-P GOP;
#       inter = videokey + SVTAV1_FRAMES=2 SVTAV1_FRAME_SHIFT=3.  C: SVT_AVIF=0 + SVT_FRAMES,
# harness: rust/tools/mem_peak.sh.  heap = heaptrack peak heap memory consumption (ONE encode
#       per cell).  rss = /usr/bin/time -v maximum resident set size, MEDIAN OF 5.
# Every cell produced a non-empty .obu; obu_before == obu_after on all 12 cells (byte-inert).
# C's obu differs from the port's on the inter arm at these sizes (the byte frontier is 64/128/256
# square) — read the inter port/C columns as two encoders doing SIMILAR, not identical, work.
